testcase.name: Scenario: Separate two custom ribbon commands: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:143:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Separate two custom ribbon commands ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model" ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches", a separator, and "3D Annotations" in that order ✔ And both commands have "Large" and "Text" clear ✔ And the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the "User Commands" panel displays the two small command icons ✔ And a vertical divider appears between the icons
